name: @local/dsh-tree-engine
description: Tree task decomposition & execution engine for DSH: plan → dispatch → bamboo-joint relay → harvest → verify, with a per-leaf relay switch (relay="off" for leaves waiting on external orchestration), bundled tree-commander/tree-worker Skills, a read-only tree_doctor self-diagnosis tool (9 tree_* tools) and the 50%-context session handoff discipline.
